clips.asr_text: Today's topic is In a Grove.
A death in a mountain thicket begins this short, unsettling story. As the mystery unfolds, consider what it takes to understand what really happened.
Listen for what the different people saw or know about the man and his wife.
So far, Takehiro has been found dead, and Masago is missing. What will Tajomaru say happened?
Tanjuromaru says he freed Takahiro and they fought with swords. What does Masago say happened after the bandit left?
cold contempt.
A strong feeling that you do not respect someone and think badly of them.
On soft feet.
Quietly, without making much sound as you walk.
Medium.
A person believed to communicate with spirits for other people.
One stab in the chest, that's what I saw.
said the woodcutter.
I found him this morning, in a thicket off the mountain road. The blood was dry. No sword or bow, sir, only rope beneath a cedar, and a comb. The broken bamboo and trampled earth showed a struggle.
I passed them yesterday at noon.
said the monk.
He carried a sword and bow; his wife rode beside him, her face veiled. I hardly looked at them. Now I wish I had.
I caught Tajomaru, the famous bandit, by the stone bridge.
said the constable.
He'd fallen from a horse, but he still had the dead man's bow. Find the woman. She'll tell you what he did.
Talking here was my daughter's husband.
said the old woman.
A gentle samurai. Masago is proud, yes, but she's only nineteen. Please find her. Don't send me home without news.
Yes, I killed him.

Said Tajo Maru, But listen, before you call me a coward, a breeze lifted her veil, and I wanted her. I promised him buried treasure, led him into the thicket, and tied him to the cedar. She fought with her dagger, but I took her by force.

Then she seized my arm. One of us must die, she said. She would go with the survivor, so I freed him. We fought fairly, sword against sword. Twenty-three strokes. No other man had lasted twenty. When he fell, she was gone. I took his weapons and left.
I crawled towards my husband after the bandit left.

said Masago at the temple. He was still tied up. I begged him to die with me, but his eyes held nothing except cold contempt for me, his own wife. I held my dagger. His lips moved, Kill me. So I stabbed him. How could I bear those eyes?
Afterwards, I tried to drown myself. I couldn't even do that. Where can I go now?
I heard the bandit comforting her.

said Takahiro's spirit through the medium. My wife said, Take me anywhere. Then she pointed at me. Kill that man. He pushed her away and asked me whether she should live or die. For that, I almost forgave him, but she fled. He cut one rope and left. I rose from the cedar and picked up the small dagger she had dropped. I stabbed myself in the chest. The thicket fell silent. Then someone crept towards me on soft feet. An unseen hand quietly drew the dagger from my chest.
I sank forever into the darkness.
